<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Cal Poly Football - Official Visit Form</title>
    <script crossorigin src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.production.min.js"></script>
    <script crossorigin src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.production.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="root"></div>
    
    <script type="text/babel">
        const { useState } = React;
        
        const uniformImages = {
          WhiteWhite: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
          WhiteGreen: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
          GreenGold: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
          WhiteGold: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
          GreenGreen: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
          GreenWhite: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
        };
        

        function CalPolyRecruitingForm() {
            const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
                fullName: '', major: '', phone: '', dateOfBirth: '', email: '',
                streetAddress: '', city: '', state: '', zipCode: '', ncaaId: '',
                guest1Name: '', guest1Relationship: '', guest2Name: '', guest2Relationship: '',
                foodAllergy: '', allergyDetails: '', transcriptSent: '',
                jerseyNumber: '', pantsSize: '', cleatSize: '', uniformCombo: ''
            });

            const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);

            const uniformOptions = [
                { value: 'WhiteWhite', label: 'White Jersey / White Pants', image: uniformImages.WhiteWhite },
                { value: 'WhiteGreen', label: 'White Jersey / Green Pants', image: uniformImages.WhiteGreen },
                { value: 'WhiteGold', label: 'White Jersey / Gold Pants', image: uniformImages.WhiteGold },
                { value: 'GreenWhite', label: 'Green Jersey / White Pants', image: uniformImages.GreenWhite },
                { value: 'GreenGreen', label: 'Green Jersey / Green Pants', image: uniformImages.GreenGreen },
                { value: 'GreenGold', label: 'Green Jersey / Gold Pants', image: uniformImages.GreenGold },
            ];

            const handleChange = (e) => {
                const { name, value } = e.target;
                setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, [name]: value }));
            };

            const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                
                try {
                    // Send to Formspree
                    const response = await fetch('https://formspree.io/f/xrepbozn', {
                        method: 'POST',
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            ...formData,
                            uniformCombo: uniformOptions.find(opt => opt.value === formData.uniformCombo)?.label
                        }),
                        headers: {
                            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                        }
                    });
                    
                    if (response.ok) {
                        setSubmitted(true);
                    } else {
                        alert('There was an error submitting the form. Please try again.');
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error:', error);
                    alert('There was an error submitting the form. Please try again.');
                }
            };

            if (submitted) {
                return (
                    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-green-800 to-green-900 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
                        <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-2xl p-8 max-w-md w-full text-center">
                            <div className="mb-6">
                                <svg className="w-16 h-16 text-green-600 mx-auto" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                                </svg>
                            </div>
                            <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-4">Thank You!</h2>
                            <p className="text-gray-700 mb-6">Your official visit information has been submitted successfully. A member of the Cal Poly football coaching staff will be in touch soon.</p>
                            <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">Go Mustangs! 🐴</p>
                            <button onClick={() => setSubmitted(false)} className="bg-green-700 text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-800 transition">
                                Submit Another Form
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                );
            }

            return (
                <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-green-800 to-green-900 py-8 px-4">
                    <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
                        <div className="bg-white rounded-t-lg shadow-lg p-8 text-center">
                            <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-2">Cal Poly Football</h1>
                            <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-yellow-600 mb-4">Official Visit Information Form</h2>
                            <p className="text-gray-600">Please complete all fields for your upcoming official visit</p>
                        </div>

                        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="bg-white shadow-lg rounded-b-lg p-8 space-y-8">
                            
                            <section className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-6">
                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-4">Personal Information</h3>
                                <div className="space-y-4">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Name (First & Last) *</label>
                                        <input type="text" name="fullName" value={formData.fullName} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="John Doe" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Major (Business, Engineering, Communication, etc?) *</label>
                                        <input type="text" name="major" value={formData.major} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="e.g., Business Administration" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                        <div>
                                            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Phone # *</label>
                                            <input type="tel" name="phone" value={formData.phone} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="(123) 456-7890" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        </div>
                                        <div>
                                            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) *</label>
                                            <input type="text" name="dateOfBirth" value={formData.dateOfBirth} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="01/15/2005" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Email Address *</label>
                                        <input type="email" name="email" value={formData.email} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="johndoe@email.com" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Home Address *</label>
                                        <input type="text" name="streetAddress" value={formData.streetAddress} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="Street Address" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent mb-2" />
                                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                                            <input type="text" name="city" value={formData.city} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="City" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                            <input type="text" name="state" value={formData.state} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="State" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                            <input type="text" name="zipCode" value={formData.zipCode} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="Zip Code" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">NCAA ID # *</label>
                                        <input type="text" name="ncaaId" value={formData.ncaaId} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="If you don't know, ask Coach Romero" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">If you don't know your NCAA ID, ask Coach Romero</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </section>

                            <section className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-6">
                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-4">Guest Information (For OV)</h3>
                                <div className="space-y-4">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Name of Guest #1 *</label>
                                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                            <input type="text" name="guest1Name" value={formData.guest1Name} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="John Doe" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                            <input type="text" name="guest1Relationship" value={formData.guest1Relationship} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="Relationship (e.g., Father)" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Name of Guest #2</label>
                                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                                            <input type="text" name="guest2Name" value={formData.guest2Name} onChange={handleChange} placeholder="Jane Doe" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                            <input type="text" name="guest2Relationship" value={formData.guest2Relationship} onChange={handleChange} placeholder="Relationship (e.g., Mother)" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </section>

                            <section className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-6">
                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-4">Dietary Information</h3>
                                <div className="space-y-4">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Do you or any of your guests have a food allergy? *</label>
                                        <select name="foodAllergy" value={formData.foodAllergy} onChange={handleChange} required className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent">
                                            <option value="">Select</option>
                                            <option value="no">No</option>
                                            <option value="yes">Yes</option>
                                        </select>
                                    </div>
                                    {formData.foodAllergy === 'yes' && (
                                        <div>
                                            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Please list the allergy(ies) *</label>
                                            <textarea name="allergyDetails" value={formData.allergyDetails} onChange={handleChange} required rows="3" placeholder="Please specify all food allergies" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </section>

                            <section className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-6">
                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-4">Transcript Information</h3>
                                <div>
                                    <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Have you sent an updated transcript with the most up to date grades to Coach Romero? *</label>
                                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mb-2">Both high school & college transcripts required</p>
                                    <select name="transcriptSent" value={formData.transcriptSent} onChange={handleChange} required className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent">
                                        <option value="">Select</option>
                                        <option value="yes">Yes</option>
                                        <option value="no">No</option>
                                    </select>
                                    {formData.transcriptSent === 'no' && (
                                        <div className="mt-2 p-3 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-lg">
                                            <p className="text-sm text-yellow-800"><strong>Please email your transcript(s) to:</strong><br />ksromero@calpoly.edu & cjwallis@calpoly.edu</p>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </section>

                            <section className="pb-6">
                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-800 mb-4">Photoshoot Information</h3>
                                <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">For the photoshoot, please provide the following information:</p>
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Jersey Number *</label>
                                        <input type="text" name="jerseyNumber" value={formData.jerseyNumber} onChange={handleChange} required placeholder="e.g., 5" className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent" />
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Pants Size *</label>
                                        <select name="pantsSize" value={formData.pantsSize} onChange={handleChange} required className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent">
                                            <option value="">Select Size</option>
                                            <option value="M">M</option>
                                            <option value="L">L</option>
                                            <option value="XL">XL</option>
                                            <option value="2XL">2XL</option>
                                            <option value="3XL">3XL</option>
                                        </select>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">Cleat Size *</label>
                                        <select name="cleatSize" value={formData.cleatSize} onChange={handleChange} required className="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:border-transparent">
                                            <option value="">Select Size</option>
                                            {[9, 9.5, 10, 10.5, 11, 11.5, 12, 12.5, 13, 13.5, 14, 14.5, 15, 15.5, 16, 16.5, 17, 17.5, 18].map(size => (
                                                <option key={size} value={size}>{size}</option>
                                            ))}
                                        </select>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <div className="mt-6">
                                    <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3">Select Your Uniform Combination *</label>
                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                                        {uniformOptions.map((option) => (
                                            <div key={option.value} onClick={() => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, uniformCombo: option.value }))}
                                                className={`cursor-pointer border-2 rounded-lg p-3 transition ${formData.uniformCombo === option.value ? 'border-green-600 bg-green-50' : 'border-gray-300 hover:border-green-400'}`}>
                                                <div className="mb-2">
                                                    <img src={option.image} alt={option.label} className="w-full h-64 object-contain rounded bg-gray-50" />
                                                </div>
                                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">{option.label}</span>
                                                    {formData.uniformCombo === option.value && (
                                                        <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 18a8 8 0 100-16 8 8 0 000 16zm3.707-9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414-1.414L9 10.586 7.707 9.293a1 1 0 00-1.414 1.414l2 2a1 1 0 001.414 0l4-4z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                                                        </svg>
                                                    )}
                                                </div>
                                            </div>
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                    {!formData.uniformCombo && (
                                        <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mt-2">Please select a uniform combination</p>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            </section>

                            <div className="text-center pt-4">
                                <button type="submit" disabled={!formData.uniformCombo}
                                    className={`font-bold py-3 px-8 rounded-lg text-lg transition transform shadow-lg ${formData.uniformCombo ? 'bg-green-700 hover:bg-green-800 text-white hover:scale-105' : 'bg-gray-400 text-gray-200 cursor-not-allowed'}`}>
                                    Submit Information
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </form>

                        <div className="bg-green-800 text-white text-center py-4 rounded-b-lg mt-0">
                            <p className="text-sm">© 2026 Cal Poly Football Recruiting | Go Mustangs!</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            );
        }

        const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
        root.render(<CalPolyRecruitingForm />);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
